properties.name: A bulk typed-edge write runs each typed helper's own checks (draw_edges), and every helper names it
properties.rationale: At the cause: the bulk form was a bypass of the helpers, not a form of them, and nothing named it. Running the helper's own body means no check exists twice. Root cause and requirement live in the live design: fact:root-cause-a-bulk-edge-form-was-offered-and-no-typed-helper-names-it-2026-09-29, req:every-typed-edge-helper-has-a-bulk-form-that-keeps-its-checks, dec:idea-every-typed-edge-helper-has-a-bulk-form-that-keeps-its-checks (not settled here).
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: I24 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29: ~270 single-edge calls built one design; create_edges was reachable for the thin helpers and named by none, and ~100 calls (constrains, governed_by, authored_by) had no bulk route that kept their checks. Fix: draw_edges takes {tool, arguments} per item and runs that helper's own body (32 helpers refactored into <helper>_on, the one code path the tool and the bulk form share) inside one atomic batch; every helper's served description names it (generated); create_edges says it is the generic form and runs no helper's checks.
